bias.en: Bearish · oversold, lowest close since April
bias.zh: 看空 · 超卖，收于 4 月以来最低

read.en: Arm fell 13.1% on Nov 5 to $166.72, trading $163.13–175.83 on 2.9 times its 20-day average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($192.75), 10-day ($208.87), 30-day ($247.13) and 100-day ($274.34) and the rising 200-day ($230.56). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 7, below zero, with the histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($231.24), and RSI is 27, oversold.
read.zh: Arm 11月5日下跌 13.1%，收于 $166.72，盘中区间 $163.13–175.83，成交量为 20 日均量的 2.9 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$192.75）、10 日（$208.87）、30 日（$247.13）和 100 日均线（$274.34）以及上行的 200 日均线（$230.56）下方。MACD 自 10月7日起位于信号线下方，处于零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$231.24），RSI 为 27，处于超卖区。

read.en: The gap lower broke the $189.9 Nov 4 low and the $183.2 support, and the close is the lowest since Apr 16. Resistance is $175.8 (Nov 5 high), then $183.2–189.9 (Oct 27, 2025 high, Nov 4 low) and $192.8–196.1 (5-day, Nov 2 low). Support is $163.1 (Nov 5 low), then $158.4 (Apr 1 high). A close above $175.8 would target $183–190; below $163.1, $158.
